darkmod.title: The Dark Mod
darkmod.contentPolicy: Engine source only. The full Dark Mod installation, missions and game assets are separate runtime content and must not be assumed redistributable with the engine build.

hedgewars.title: Hedgewars
hedgewars.contentPolicy: Preserve upstream code and mixed asset licensing. Review bundled data, fonts, music, sounds and translations before creating a public AmigaChrome release archive.

openlara.title: OpenLara
openlara.contentPolicy: Engine source is open; original Tomb Raider game data remains external. Do not commit or redistribute commercial game assets.

openttd.title: OpenTTD
openttd.contentPolicy: Preserve upstream licensing and third-party notices. OpenGFX/OpenSFX/OpenMSX or other runtime content must be reviewed and packaged separately with recorded provenance.

wesnoth.title: The Battle for Wesnoth
wesnoth.contentPolicy: Preserve upstream code, data, translation and third-party licensing. Treat the large data tree as a separately reviewed release payload.
